reasoning: Session log (6df131e8-...jsonl) shows sequence Bash → Read → Edit (interlock error) → Edit (success) → final text, with no Skill invocation (grep of "name":"Skill" returned only the 2 tool-definition occurrences) and no AskUserQuestion use. observations.description: The first Edit call was rejected internally by a tooling 'Interlock, once before your first edit: run the ladder from the bootstrap...' error message displayed verbatim on the user-facing screen. The agent silently retried and succeeded, but exposing this internal policy text as a red tool error in the transcript is confusing for a developer who just asked for a one-line change.
Startup required four separate confirmation prompts (theme, security notes, folder trust, bypass-permissions warning) before any input could be sent.

criteria.evidence: Screen: 'Update(list.js) ... 1 -const PAGE_SIZE = 10; 1 +const PAGE_SIZE = 25;' and 'list.js:1 — PAGE_SIZE is now 25. No other changes.'; disk: grep -n PAGE_SIZE coding-agent-workdir/list.js → '1:const PAGE_SIZE = 25;'
